newsitem.title: USA: Ohio 1,205 MW Perry nuclear plant to restart Wed..
newsitem.headline: Ohio 1,205 MW Perry nuclear plant to restart Wed..

text.p: The 1,205 megawatt (MW) Perry nuclear power plant in North Perry, Ohio, was scheduled to startup later Wednesday after tripping off line Tuesday due to an electrical problem, the operator said.
"We're hoping to restart the reactor this afternoon. We hope to produce power tomorrow," said a Centerior Energy Corp spokesman.

Early Tuesday, the plant's reactor scrammed after its inverter lost its power source. Engineers, at the time, were replacing the inverter, an electronic component in a system that monitors the plant's feedwater level.
Perry was producing at 100 percent power before the shutdown.
Centerior is the majority owner of the plant. Ohio Edison and DQE Inc are the other owners of Perry.
